## Change

What changed, why, and which BUILD item does it address?

## Verification

Actual commands/results, input and code revision, and checks not run. Do not call a scaffold or mock a verified runtime.

## Interface and scientific impact

Any schema, units, constraints, numerical assumptions or producer/consumer changes? Who needs to coordinate?

## Risks and limits

Known gaps, data/permission implications, and a reversible recovery path where applicable.

Keep the PR as a draft and do not request reviewers until the agreed review gate is approved.
